# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-tool-docs.js — do not edit by hand. Run `npm run docs`. -->

MCP tools exposed by the `openrouter` server (plugin version 0.1.0). In Claude Code they appear as
`mcp__plugin_openrouter_openrouter__<tool>`; you normally just describe what you want and Claude picks the tool.

| Tool | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`chat`](#chat) | Send a prompt to any OpenRouter model (OpenAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI...) and return its text answer. |
| [`generate_image`](#generate_image) | Generate images, or edit them from reference images, with an OpenRouter image model. |
| [`text_to_speech`](#text_to_speech) | Turn text into speech with an OpenRouter TTS model and save it (mp3, or wav built from the pcm stream). |
| [`transcribe`](#transcribe) | Transcribe speech from an audio file or URL to text (speech-to-text). |
| [`generate_audio`](#generate_audio) | Generate audio through a chat model with audio output: music (e.g. |
| [`generate_video`](#generate_video) | Start a video generation job (text-to-video, image-to-video with first/last frame, or guided by reference images), wait up to wait_seconds, and download the mp4 if ready; otherwise return a job id for video_status. |
| [`video_status`](#video_status) | Check a video job started by generate_video, optionally wait, and download the video(s) once completed.. |
| [`embeddings`](#embeddings) | Compute embedding vectors for texts. |
| [`list_models`](#list_models) | List OpenRouter models with modalities, prices and (for TTS) voices. |
| [`model_details`](#model_details) | Details for one model: description, modalities, voices, accepted parameters and allowed values (image sizes, video durations...), prices, and per-provider capabilities (voice cloning, diarization...).. |
| [`credits`](#credits) | Show the OpenRouter account credits purchased and used so far.. |

## `chat`

Send a prompt to any OpenRouter model (OpenAI, Google, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI...) and return its text answer. Attachments (local paths or URLs) are sent as multimodal input: images, audio, video, PDF, for models that accept them. Defaults to "openrouter/auto". Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | yes | The user message. |
| `model` | string | no | OpenRouter model id, e.g. "google/gemini-2.5-pro". |
| `system` | string | no | Optional system prompt. |
| `attachments` | string[] | no | Local file paths or http(s) URLs (image, audio, video, pdf). |
| `temperature` | number | no |  (min 0, max 2) |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no |  (min 1) |

## `generate_image`

Generate images, or edit them from reference images, with an OpenRouter image model. Saves the files and returns their paths. Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices. (output_modality "image")

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | yes |  |
| `model` | string | yes | Image model id. |
| `reference_images` | string[] | no | Local paths or URLs of images to edit or take inspiration from. |
| `aspect_ratio` | string | no | e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16", "4:3", "3:2", "21:9" or "auto". |
| `resolution` | `512` \| `768` \| `1K` \| `1.5K` \| `2K` \| `4K` | no |  |
| `size` | string | no | Shorthand: a tier ("2K") or exact pixels ("2048x2048"). Do not combine pixels with resolution/aspect_ratio. |
| `quality` | `auto` \| `low` \| `medium` \| `high` | no |  |
| `background` | `auto` \| `transparent` \| `opaque` | no | "transparent" needs png or webp. |
| `output_format` | `png` \| `jpeg` \| `webp` \| `svg` | no |  |
| `n` | integer | no | Number of images. (min 1, max 10) |
| `seed` | integer | no |  |
| `output_dir` | string | no | Where to save; defaults to OPENROUTER_OUTPUT_DIR (./openrouter-output). |

## `text_to_speech`

Turn text into speech with an OpenRouter TTS model and save it (mp3, or wav built from the pcm stream). Supports multi-speaker dialogue (turns) and voice cloning from a short reference recording on models that allow it. Most models need a voice: get the list with model_details. Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices. (output_modality "speech")

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | no | Text to read. Use this or turns. |
| `turns` | object[] | no | Multi-speaker dialogue (Gemini TTS, Fish Audio...): each turn has text and optionally its own voice and instructions. |
| `model` | string | yes | TTS model id. |
| `voice` | string | no | Voice id, model-specific. |
| `instructions` | string | no | Tone, pacing or emotion, e.g. "warm and slow" (OpenAI, Gemini, Fish Audio). |
| `speed` | number | no | Playback speed multiplier, if the model supports it. |
| `voice_references` | string[] | no | Voice cloning: 1-3 audio clips (local paths or URLs), optionally one image. Omit voice when cloning. |
| `reference_transcript` | string | no | Transcript of the first reference clip, if known. |
| `format` | `mp3` \| `pcm` | no | Requested format. If omitted, mp3 is tried first, then pcm (saved as wav). |
| `output_path` | string | no | File to write; defaults to a new file in the output dir. |

## `transcribe`

Transcribe speech from an audio file or URL to text (speech-to-text). Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices. (output_modality "transcription")

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `audio` | string | yes | Local audio file path or http(s) URL (wav, mp3, m4a, flac, ogg, webm, aac). |
| `model` | string | yes | Transcription model id. |
| `language` | string | no | ISO-639-1 code, e.g. "fr". Auto-detected if omitted. |
| `diarize` | boolean | no | Label who speaks, on models that support it. |
| `timestamps` | boolean | no | Return timestamped segments. |
| `keyterms` | string[] | no | Names or jargon to help recognition, on models that support it. |

## `generate_audio`

Generate audio through a chat model with audio output: music (e.g. google/lyria-3-clip-preview, google/lyria-3-pro-preview) or a spoken answer (e.g. openai/gpt-audio). Saves the audio and returns its path and any text/transcript. For plain text-to-speech prefer text_to_speech. Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices. (output_modality "audio")

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | yes | What to create or say (e.g. a music description with genre, mood, tempo, lyrics). |
| `model` | string | yes |  |
| `attachments` | string[] | no | Optional images or audio given as input, as in chat. |
| `voice` | string | no | Voice for spoken output models (e.g. "alloy"). |
| `format` | string | no | Audio format requested from the model (e.g. "pcm16", "wav", "mp3"). Model-specific. |
| `output_path` | string | no |  |

## `generate_video`

Start a video generation job (text-to-video, image-to-video with first/last frame, or guided by reference images), wait up to wait_seconds, and download the mp4 if ready; otherwise return a job id for video_status. Check durations, resolutions and prices with model_details first: video can be expensive. Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices. (output_modality "video")

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | yes |  |
| `model` | string | yes | Video model id. |
| `duration` | integer | no | Seconds; must be one of the model supported durations. |
| `resolution` | string | no | e.g. "480p", "720p", "1080p", "4K". |
| `aspect_ratio` | string | no | e.g. "16:9", "9:16", "1:1". |
| `size` | string | no | Exact pixels "WIDTHxHEIGHT", instead of resolution + aspect_ratio. |
| `first_frame` | string | no | Image (path or URL) to start the video from. |
| `last_frame` | string | no | Image (path or URL) to end the video on. |
| `reference_images` | string[] | no | Style or subject references (ignored if a frame is given). |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | no |  |
| `seed` | integer | no |  |
| `wait_seconds` | integer | no |  (min 0, max 280, default `90`) |
| `output_dir` | string | no |  |

## `video_status`

Check a video job started by generate_video, optionally wait, and download the video(s) once completed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `job_id` | string | yes |  |
| `wait_seconds` | integer | no |  (min 0, max 280, default `0`) |
| `output_dir` | string | no |  |

## `embeddings`

Compute embedding vectors for texts. Vectors are written to a JSON file (path returned). Use list_models (with the matching output_modality) to find a model id, and model_details for its voices, accepted parameters and prices. (output_modality "embeddings")

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | string[] | yes |  |
| `model` | string | yes |  |
| `dimensions` | integer | no |  (min 1) |
| `output_path` | string | no |  |

## `list_models`

List OpenRouter models with modalities, prices and (for TTS) voices. output_modality: text, image, speech (TTS), transcription (STT), audio (music / spoken chat), video, embeddings, rerank, or "all".

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output_modality` | string | no | Comma-separated; defaults to "all". |
| `input_modality` | string | no | Comma-separated: text, image, audio, file. |
| `search` | string | no | Filter on model id or name, e.g. "gemini". |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (min 1, max 200, default `40`) |

## `model_details`

Details for one model: description, modalities, voices, accepted parameters and allowed values (image sizes, video durations...), prices, and per-provider capabilities (voice cloning, diarization...).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | string | yes |  |

## `credits`

Show the OpenRouter account credits purchased and used so far.

_No parameters._
